scope: Reduce port/junction false positives with reviewed real point labels and sparse context classifiers; improve actual adjacency with evidence-gated hybrid routing; avoid full-page six-channel CNN inference at runtime. Keep v6 symbol detector unchanged to isolate topology.

policy: Select nontrivial source ROIs by source inspection before inference. One human-like model annotator visually transcribes, no engineering certification. Known projects, potential revisions, not independent projects. Freeze labels and final models/runtime before test inference; no threshold fitting on test. Previously inspected pages reported only as training/validation/regression. Report end-to-end and conditional-on-detected-endpoints recall, precision/F1 and paired latency, candidate point precision/recall. Do not claim success if hybrid gains are only from a larger output budget. Deploy best validated bounded CPU option, all results remain needs_review.
